rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact: price is trading below both VWAP ($54.10) and the 9-EMA ($53.60) on 5x relative volume after a failed gap, with the tape mildly risk-off (SPY -0.24%, VIXY +1.10%), and the bounce off the $52.60 low is stalling on fading volume (last closes 53.28/53.28 with shrinking size). Reward to the $52.30 target (~$257) is still roughly 2x the risk to the $53.75 invalidation (~$120), and no new headline or reversal signal (no VWAP reclaim, no higher low confirmed) justifies exiting or flipping long into a downtrend. The main caution is midday chop near the day's low, hence moderate confidence rather than adding.
